author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/47-trust-model.md — REQ-3, REQ-6, REQ-7, AC-6, AC-7 + decomposition PR 5.

## Surface
- New file: `polaris-trust/src/templates.rs` — shipped default policies:
  - `MODERATE_SPAM_30D_DECAY` — flat 0.7, per_category{spam: 0.85}, half_life 30d
  - `HIGH_CSAM_NO_DECAY` — flat 1.0, per_category{csam: 1.0}, no decay
  - `LOW_HARASSMENT_7D_DECAY` — flat 0.3, per_category{harassment: 0.5}, half_life 7d
- New file: `polaris-backend/src/admin/trust_policy.rs` — admin endpoints
- Endpoints:
  - `GET /api/admin/upstream-labelers/{id}/trust-policy` → returns current policy
  - `POST /api/admin/upstream-labelers/{id}/trust-policy` → updates policy, validates via `polaris_trust::validate()`, writes audit-log entry
- Migration: one-time data migration adds `"version": "1"` to existing `weights JSONB` rows (Q4-B).

## Rust-quality notes
- **Templates are `const` static** — `pub static MODERATE_SPAM_30D_DECAY: LazyLock<TrustPolicy> = LazyLock::new(|| TrustPolicy::V2 { … });`. Compile-time validated via a `#[test] fn templates_are_valid()` that calls `validate()` on each.
- **Save endpoint validates BEFORE writing**: 400 Bad Request with the structured `TrustPolicyError` message on bad input (REQ-7 / AC-6). Per rust-quality §3: error mapping at the axum layer.
- **Audit-log entry on change** writes a `kind = "trust-policy-change"` entry containing serialized old + new policy. Per REQ-6 / AC-7: the v1 hash-chained audit log absorbs this naturally.
- **One-time data migration**: a sqlx migration `NNN_trust_policy_versioning.sql` runs `UPDATE upstream_labelers SET weights = jsonb_set(weights, '{version}', '"1"') WHERE weights ->> 'version' IS NULL`. Idempotent.
- Per rust-quality §10: the admin handler uses a `sqlx::Transaction` so the audit-log entry and the policy update are atomic.

## External references
- axum response patterns: https://docs.rs/axum/0.8/axum/response/index.html
- `std::sync::LazyLock`: https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/sync/struct.LazyLock.html
- sqlx migrations: https://docs.rs/sqlx-cli/latest/sqlx_cli/

## Acceptance (AC-6, AC-7)
- [ ] AC-6: POST a policy with `flat: 1.5` → 400 with code `weight_out_of_range`.
- [ ] AC-7: POST a valid policy change → `audit_log` row with `kind = "trust-policy-change"` and both old and new policy embedded.
- [ ] All three shipped templates pass `validate()`.
